notes.title: Yuki’s Tale - A FREE and Major Update Announcement
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34433219/c908277de41bebcf47b2c9c12f8cd233d6976ec1.jpg[/img]

Hello, everyone!

We’re so excited to say [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1023260/Yukis_Tale/]Yuki’s Tale[/url] will get a FREE and major update this month. To celebrate 3 years of its launching day, we've prepared a huge visual update including new concepts art, gameplay improvements, a new character with a new side quest and a new adult scene, and much more. Also, all h-scenes have been rewritten and new arts have been made for them.

The update is scheduled for April 14th and it will not be a DLC. So, if you have the game, you'll automatically get it free. If you don’t, you should buy it asap because when the update happens, the game price will be increased by one dollar - totalizing $6,99.

On April 14th, we'll detail all improvements as well as the new content. Until then, check out a new H-scene!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34433219/4a54a6176a2e689037832a33ac2c2138c26af6bb.png[/img]

Thank you all for supporting us and we hope you enjoy all [url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/maledoll/list/58737]upcoming releases[/url].

notes.title: Yuki's Tale 1.02
notes.content:
Hello, dolls!

I would like to say I made some updates trying to improve an usability aspect of Yuki's Tale, and also in our main menu. Check it out:

[h1]Directions orientations inside the builds[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34433219/f4cb00fd300203b168971737e10933e42efb3e03.gif[/img]

Now, when you enter the buildings in the city (Blarney, Roseta and Gilbratar) directions will appear showing you the exit or available ways. It's just an improvement to give more guidance to players and reduce possible mistakes. 

[h1]Credits on the main menu[/h1]

I have implemented this option in the main menu because as our family in Male Doll's Patreon is growing, they may want to see their names on the game. At first, you needed to complete the full game to watch the credits; now you can see it by clicking on the main menu.

[h1]Visual Update on Blarney City[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34433219/5251394dd7778fbf875f508fd546693f59f41cbc.png[/img]

I made some visual improvements on Blarney's map. Now the buildings have different types of roofs bringing them closer to reality. I hope you guys like it!

[h1]Portuguese Version Removed from the store[/h1]

It is a lot of work having two different versions of the same game. Every time I need to do some adjustments, it’s necessary to do them in both versions.The Portuguese speakers aren't the main audience of Male Doll's games so that's why I have removed Yuki's Tale Portuguese version from the store. This can result in more time to invest in the English one. Thank you all for understanding.

I hope these improvements can give a better experience for Yuki's Tale. Thank for your support.

XoXo
Victoria

notes.title: Small improvements (Yuki's Tale One Month Anniversary)
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34433219/7bc54b3d09242988a1e2ce1dc477a0b27661e2c2.jpg[/img]

Hello everyone!

Yuki's Tale completed one month since launching, and based on community feedback, I’ve made some improvements. You can check below.

[h1]Textual and sound feedback on the 'rock puzzle' in Shadow's Cave (second floor).[/h1]
Now, after you push the rock to the hole, you'll hear a sound and Yuki says “What is this noise?”. My goal is to make it easier for people to understand that you need to move another rock to complete the puzzle downstairs.

[h1]'Casual' bug on Maze's prison map.[/h1]
If you move the rocks in a wrong way, you can block Maze's moment (after you rescue him) and the game will lock up. After this feedback by blackbiyrd on Yuki's Tale Steam Forum, I fixed it by adding an event after you complete the puzzle. Now, on the fourth floor in Shadow's Cave, after you move the rocks to go to the other side, the rocks vanish preventing this problem to happen.

[h1]Feedback about what you need to do after you run away from the big monster in the duct passage in Gibraltar.[/h1]
Now, after you run away from the big monster, a message appears telling you what you need to do to break the magic seal.

I hope these improvements make the experience of Yuki's Tale even better, and if you have more suggestions, feel free to comment on our forum or join in Male Doll's Discord! I'll love to talk to you! 

Stay tuned and help Male Doll on our next project. BTW, add Agent Lovesdick to your wishlist now! :)

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1054470/Agent_Lovesdick

Thank you for all of your support and I hope you'll enjoy our upcoming release!
